(2) The scene shifts to a brightly lit room where the woman is now dressed in a white puff-sleeve dress with a pearl collar, smiling at the camera with groomed hair and makeup. (3) She applies a lip balm stick and then uses a liquid lipstick, dabbing it on her cheeks and lips. She holds the M.A.C lipstick tube next to her face, smiling broadly. (4) The woman is now in a school corridor or hall, laughing and waving her hands as she interacts with a man whose back is partially visible. (5) In a professional setting, she wears a black leather jacket over a black top, sitting in front of a silver laptop. She applies a different shade of red lipstick. (6) She is seen in a cafe-like setting, wearing a light-colored top with pearls and denim straps, surprised while holding a mug before applying more liquid lipstick. (7) In a dressing room with bright mirror lights, she wears a silver sequined dress and applies a pinkish lipstick shade. (8) Close-up shots of her arm show four distinct lipstick swatches. (9) A split-screen displays her in the four different outfits simultaneously, applying various lipstick shades. (10) The video ends with a close-up of three M.A.C lipstick products standing on a wooden surface.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, percussive ringing of an old-fashioned alarm clock, followed immediately by a woman's high-arousal scream and an audible yawn. (2) A synthesized 'whoosh' transition marks the shift as an upbeat, high-tempo pop instrumental track with a strong drum machine beat begins. (3) A male narrator with a professional and clear tone begins describing the product's benefits in Mandarin, his voice perfectly synchronized with the rhythm. (4) A sharp digital 'click' sound accompanies the woman's transformation on screen. (5) Mechanical keyboard typing sounds and a digital 'ding' notification sound are heard during the office scene, integrated into the music bed. (6) A subtle liquid pouring and clinking sound occurs when the woman is seen with a mug, followed by a 'pop' sound effect as she applies lipstick. (7) A camera shutter sound effect triggers as she poses in the sequined dress. (8) The narrator concludes the promotional pitch with high vocal confidence as the music reaches a bright, percussive finale with a brand stinger.
